lines.en: Over 127 thousand customer reviews. 41 French brands. Most of them, nobody reads.
lines.fr: Plus de 127 000 avis clients. 41 marques françaises. La plupart, personne ne les lit.
lines.tts: Over 127 thousand customer reviews. 41 French brands. Most of them, nobody reads.

lines.en: Banks, telecoms, retailers, transport. Customers say exactly what is broken, and the signal gets lost.
lines.fr: Banques, télécoms, distribution, transport. Les clients disent exactement ce qui ne va pas, et le signal se perd.
lines.tts: Banks, telecoms, retailers, transport. Customers say exactly what is broken, and the signal gets lost.

lines.en: I'm Écoute, an AI agent. I read every review, minutes after it is posted.
lines.fr: Je suis Écoute, un agent IA. Je lis chaque avis, quelques minutes après sa publication.
lines.tts: I'm [Écoute](/eɪkˈuːt/), an AI agent. I read every review, minutes after it is posted.

lines.en: I sort each one into fifteen pain points, and measure what each one costs in stars.
lines.fr: Je classe chacun parmi quinze irritants, et je mesure ce que chacun coûte en étoiles.
lines.tts: I sort each one into fifteen pain points, and measure what each one costs in stars.

lines.en: At Deliveroo, delivery problems cost 0.43 stars. Fix half of them, and the rating climbs from 2.49 to 2.70.
lines.fr: Chez Deliveroo, les livraisons coûtent 0,43 étoile. Corrigez-en la moitié, et la note passe de 2,49 à 2,70.
lines.tts: At Deliveroo, delivery problems cost 0.43 stars. Fix half of them, and the rating climbs from 2.49 to 2.70.

lines.en: When complaints spike, I investigate. On November 10, E.Leclerc complaints jumped. I traced them to version 11.0.1: crashes and failed logins, and briefed the team.
lines.fr: Quand les plaintes explosent, j'enquête. Le 10 novembre, les plaintes sur E.Leclerc ont bondi. J'ai remonté la piste jusqu'à la version 11.0.1 : plantages et connexions impossibles, et j'ai alerté l'équipe.
lines.tts: When complaints spike, I investigate. On November 10, E.Leclerc complaints jumped. I traced them to version 11.0.1: crashes and failed logins, and briefed the team.

lines.en: Fix what customers actually feel, and angry reviews turn into loyal ones.
lines.fr: Corrigez ce que les clients ressentent vraiment, et les avis en colère deviennent des avis fidèles.
lines.tts: Fix what customers actually feel, and angry reviews turn into loyal ones.
